output.question: When is Snap's next earnings report?
output.answer: Snap has not yet announced the date of its next earnings report, which will cover Q4 and full-year 2026. Going by its usual schedule, that report would most likely come in early February 2027, but this is an estimate, not a confirmed date. Snap last reported on November 4, 2026, when it released Q3 2026 results: revenue of $1,722 million (up 14% year over year), net income of $56 million and Adjusted EBITDA of $383 million. The upcoming events section of Snap's investor relations site was empty when checked.

key_facts.fact: Snap released its Q3 2026 results (quarter ended September 30, 2026) on November 4, 2026, and held its earnings call that day at 2:00 p.m. PT / 5:00 p.m. ET.
Q3 2026 revenue was $1,722 million, up 14% year over year. Net income was $56 million and Adjusted EBITDA was $383 million.
The Q3 2026 press release does not give the date of the next earnings report.
When checked, the upcoming events section of Snap's investor relations page listed no events, including no Q4 2026 earnings date.
Snap reported last year's fourth quarter (Q4 2025) in early February: an SEC search result lists an 8-K press-release exhibit dated 2026-02-04. That filing was not opened.

Some third-party earnings calendars still list November 4, 2026 as the 'next' report, or other dates such as October 15, 2026. Those listings are out of date because the Q3 report has already happened.
Snap usually announces its earnings date a few weeks ahead on investor.snap.com, so check there for the confirmed date.
